# Error Handling Checklist: G56R-003 Evaluation Runner, Fixtures, Scoring, and Statistical Analysis

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for fail-closed catalog publication, exact-treatment failures, score and adjudication error classes, rerun/attrition policy, budget/cancellation terminal handling, and no-qualification outcomes.
**Created**: 2026-07-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It tests requirements quality, not implementation behavior.

## Catalog And Snapshot Failures

- [x] CHK001 Does the spec require empty source/runtime intersections to block authoritative freeze publication rather than reusing or rewriting the archived G56R-002 zero freeze? [Completeness, Spec FR-001, Spec FR-028, Spec SC-016]
- [x] CHK002 Are malformed source ledgers and malformed pinned runtime catalogs represented as snapshot authority failures rather than tuple-local exclusions? [Consistency, Spec FR-028, Spec FR-029, Contract successor-capability-freeze]
- [x] CHK003 Are stale catalog collections, untrusted collection authority, sanitization failure, retention failure, identity mismatch, digest mismatch, and historical mutation all defined as publication blockers? [Coverage, Spec FR-028, Data Model Runtime Catalog Collection, Contract successor-capability-freeze]
- [x] CHK004 Are unsupported efforts, source-only efforts, unknown canonical efforts, hidden-state disagreement, surface disagreement, and unavailable runtime support given closed exclusion outcomes? [Completeness, Spec FR-003, Spec FR-029, Contract successor-capability-freeze]
- [x] CHK005 Are app-server, hidden, picker, bundled, cache, source-inventory, default, alias, aggregate, Ultra, and topology-changing observations prohibited from admitting ordinary per-agent tuples? [Boundary, Spec FR-004, Spec FR-005, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Does the data model require invalid capability snapshots to remain diagnostic evidence only and prevent them from feeding a successor freeze? [Measurability, Data Model Runtime Capability Snapshot, Data Model Successor Capability Freeze]

## Fixture, Scorer, Ballot, And Adjudication Failures

- [x] CHK014 Are invalid or stale fixtures required to fail before candidate scoring rather than being rescued by semantic scorer judgment? [Sequencing, Spec FR-033, Research Decision 5, Data Model Role Fixture Contract]
- [x] CHK015 Are invalid, stale, non-blind, missing, or provenance-incomplete scorer ballots prohibited from satisfying semantic scoring requirements? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, Spec FR-035, Data Model Semantic Ballot]
- [x] CHK016 Does the spec require two distinct scorer identities and executions before semantic scoring can be accepted? [Measurability, Spec FR-015, Spec FR-035, Spec SC-006]

- [x] CHK019 Are adjudicator identity, calibration, currentness, version/digest, and non-reuse of primary ballot scorers specified strongly enough to prevent stale or biased disagreement resolution? [Clarity, Research Decision 6, Data Model Adjudication]

## Terminal Outcomes, Attrition, And Reruns

- [x] CHK021 Are candidate-caused failures, timeouts, cancellations, budget exhaustion, and abandoned work retained in the assigned pair with acceptance zero? [Completeness, Spec FR-020, Spec SC-009]
- [x] CHK022 Does the plan prohibit complete-case filtering and prevent silently discarding failed, timed-out, cancelled, budget-exhausted, or abandoned attempts? [Boundary, Spec FR-020, Research Decision 8, Plan Statistical Decision Order]
- [x] CHK023 Are independently preclassified transient harness failures the only rerun-eligible failure class? [Clarity, Spec FR-021, Research Decision 9, Data Model Experiment Policy]
- [x] CHK024 Are reruns required to rerun the complete pair under a frozen cap, with no one-arm retry path? [Measurability, Spec FR-021, Spec SC-010, Contract experiment-policy]
- [x] CHK025 Is unresolved evidence after the rerun cap required to become inconclusive rather than complete-case filtered or reclassified as candidate quality? [Coverage, Spec Clarifications Session 4, Spec FR-021, Research Decision 9]
- [x] CHK026 Does the spec or plan define how unknown or unclassifiable attrition is handled before terminal analysis, separate from candidate-caused outcomes and independently preclassified transient harness failures? [Completeness, Spec FR-021, Plan Score Failure Code Taxonomy, Plan Statistical Decision Order]
- [x] CHK027 Are campaign budgets and time/token limits required before live execution, and is budget exhaustion treated as a terminal assigned outcome? [Completeness, Spec FR-020, Spec FR-022, Data Model Experiment Policy]
- [x] CHK028 Are cancellation states and abandoned work covered as explicit terminal states rather than implicit missing evidence? [Coverage, Spec FR-020, G56R-002 treatment-record schema, Contract score-bundle]

## Decision Boundary And No-Qualification Policy

- [x] CHK029 Does the decision sequence require evidence/binding checks, treatment eligibility, deterministic gates, provenance, and completeness before statistical qualification logic? [Sequencing, Plan Statistical Decision Order, Data Model Analysis Output]
- [x] CHK030 Are absolute semantic and reliability floors required before paired non-inferiority, and non-inferiority before raw-vector Pareto comparison? [Sequencing, Spec FR-017, Spec FR-018, Spec SC-007]
- [x] CHK031 Does every failed gate, tie, mixed dominance, missing evidence, incomplete pair, or statistical uncertainty produce no qualification instead of a forced ranking? [Coverage, Spec FR-019, Spec SC-008, Plan Statistical Decision Order]
- [x] CHK032 Is calibration permanently barred from emitting `qualified`, final preferred/fallback policies, installed defaults, aggregate identities, or release claims? [Boundary, Spec FR-013, Spec FR-024, Data Model Decision Bundle]
- [x] CHK033 Are qualification decisions replayable from frozen experiment, score, analysis, and decision bundles without live evidence mutation? [Measurability, Spec FR-010, Spec FR-032, Spec SC-011]
- [x] CHK034 Are route-ordering decisions limited to frozen balanced or seeded assignment policy before execution and quality-first Pareto decisions after eligibility gates, avoiding post-hoc weighted rankings? [Consistency, Plan Statistical Decision Order, Contract experiment-policy, Research Decision 8]
- [x] CHK035 Are final outcome-bearing per-agent campaigns and route policies explicitly deferred to G56R-007 through G56R-010? [Scope, Spec FR-024, Design Concept Q10]
